body.statement: If the exhaustive extension property in Open-ended Question 1 holds, then for every signed weight vector \(w\), \[\Theta_I(w;P_{\mathrm{obs}})=\left\{\sum_{j\in\mathcal J}w_j\nu_j-s(w)^{\mathsf T}\beta:\beta\in\mathcal Q_Y(\mu)\right\}.\] Hence the joint identified region for \((\theta_j)_{j\in\mathcal J}\) is exactly the affine image of \(\mathcal Q_Y(\mu)\), and every exposed endpoint is attained by one full law rather than by target-specific laws.
body.justification: This is the causal sharpness payoff: one polyhedral object supports all overlapping group--time effects and all signed aggregates.
body.gap: CallawaySantAnna2021, Theorem 1 point-identifies each group--time effect after choosing clean never- or not-yet-treated comparisons. Gong2022 and Fenaroli2026 bound anticipation in smaller or never-treated settings; none gives a joint causal fiber for contaminated not-yet-treated controls.
body.consumer: The result replaces a collection of separately computed sensitivity intervals by one coherent identified region for event-time, group, and calendar-time summaries.
